name: com.aussiesats/aussiesats
title: AussieSats
description: Live ranking of Australian Bitcoin exchanges by sats received for A$1,000 after fees and spread.

tools.name: get_sats_per_dollar
tools.description: How many sats (1 Bitcoin = 100,000,000 sats) A$1,000 buys right now on each Australian Bitcoin exchange, after deposit fees, trading fees and spread, through its cheapest AUD route. Returns the live ranking (most sats first), the exchanges that are shown but not ranked, each one's all-in cost, data label and reading time, and the BTC/AUD reference price. Checked every 5 minutes. Measured for A$1,000 only; for other amounts the all-in cost is a rough guide. General information, not financial advice.

exchange.description: Optional. One exchange to return instead of all of them, by id.

tools.name: get_week_summary
tools.description: How Australian Bitcoin exchanges compared over the last 7 days (or since checks began, if that is shorter), for A$1,000 through each one's cheapest AUD route. Returns each ranked Live exchange's average all-in cost (deposit fee, trading fee and spread, averaged over every 5-minute check), the cheapest and dearest on average and the gap between them in dollars, how often each exchange was #1 and how many times #1 changed hands, and how the BTC/AUD reference price moved. Use get_sats_per_dollar for the ranking right now. General information, not financial advice.
